title: About Us
description:
The Closed Joint Stock Company “Radioisotope Production Center” produces F18 radioactive isotope through Cyclot 18/18 accelerator.

The function of producing isotope directly in the center is the only one in the region and very significant given the short half-life of F18 radioactive isotope.

Conversion of the F18 radioisotope to the radiopharmaceutical F18 fluorodeoxyglucose. Use of F18 FDG in Positron Emission Tomography - Computed Tomography (PET / CT).

The Philips PET-CT equipment in the center is the first and only one in the territory of the Republic of Armenia. Single-Photon Emission Tomography - Computed Tomography (SPECT / CT).

Computed Tomography (CT)
